plan.title: EXP-DRAFT-035 – Vendor add control absent on saved eRFX draft

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test tenant.
Set the condition under test so vendor addition is prevented during event creation.
Apply the case's required tenant configuration for saved eRFX drafts.
Apply a template so the draft has a configured stage.
Add the minimum line item needed for a usable saved draft.
Complete the draft's pricing sheet before saving.
Create the saved eRFX draft used by the test.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Confirm the draft created by this plan appears in the Drafts list.
Open the saved draft from the Drafts list.
Assert that the vendor-addition control named by the case is not offered on the saved draft.
